description: 没有训练/推理 FLOPs、wall-clock、显存或成本表。

name: prompt_injection_robustness
description: 引言提到 activation steering 的 adversarial promise，但实验没有 prompt injection 或 jailbreak test。

name: component_deletion
description: Table 3 deletes RFT, TTI, and TDS on WebShop; every deletion lowers Task Score and Success versus full T2PO.

name: alternative_thinking_control
description: Table 4 compares lengthy reward, short CoT cold-start, void turn filtering, and hard thinking budget; TTI+TDS is highest on both metrics.
evidence_sections: 5.4. Ablation on Other Thinking Control Methods

name: optimizer_replacement
description: GSPO replacement on WebShop raises Success from 85.18 to 91.79 after TTI+TDS.
evidence_sections: D.1. Ablation Study on other Policy Optimization Algorithm

name: alpha_sensitivity
description: α sweep .2/.4/.6/.8 selects .4; both Success and Task Score peak at .4.

name: response_length_sensitivity
description: Figure 6 tests max response 300/500/700; 300 clips many outputs, 500 is final setting, and 700 does not increase final average length.
evidence_sections: D.2. Ablation Study on Token-level Response Length

name: environment_efficiency
description: Figure 7 repeats token/turn efficiency analysis on ALFWorld and reports approximately 16% fewer turns.

name: staleness_robustness
description: Table 6 varies rollout batch and prompt group settings with Bupdate fixed; the three point rows remain close.

name: missing_epsilon_eta_N_sweeps
description: The main text says it investigates α, ε, η, and N, but Appendix D presents only α sensitivity and response-length analysis; no independent ε/η/N sweep was found.
evidence_sections: 5.3. Ablation on Key Modules|D.3. Sensitivity Analysis on α

name: failure_cases
description: Appendix G gives a token-level truncation failure, repeated-turn failure, and T2PO successful action case; these are representative qualitative examples.

name: implicit_negative_sampling
description: 只保留 forward progress [0,1] 后，stick-push 和 basketball 下降；失败抓取易被估为 partial success。

name: weighted_pair_sampling
description: uniform sampling 替代 1/Δ 后，stick-push 和 window-open 下降，局部接触变化更难分辨。

name: two_hot_discretization
description: direct regression 在 basketball 和 disassemble 下降，brief decisive action 被平滑。

name: only_from_init
description: 以 initial frame 为 anchor、预测 [0,1] progress；结果低于 TR。

name: single_frame_input
description: 只用单帧预测 normalized temporal position；结果低于 TR。

name: order_prediction
description: 均匀取 32 帧、随机置乱、按 permutation position cross-entropy 训练；额外复杂度没有稳定收益。

name: reward_combination_alpha
description: α 固定/自适应的性能曲线相近；自适应规则为前 100 trajectories 的 dense reward 最大值的 10 倍。

name: vip_backbone
description: VIP 的 ResNet-34 与 ViT-B 任务间表现有变，但 TR 均胜出，差距不能归因于 backbone。

name: visual_pretraining
description: scratch ViT 使绝对性能下降，但 TR 相对趋势保留。

name: progressor_negative_sampling
description: 给 PROGRESSOR 加 negative sampling 改善 window-close/drawer-open，却不能解决 basketball/stick-push 的结构性差距。

name: proxy_only
description: 去掉 sparse environment reward 后 200k frames 内无 success；是主要负面结果。

name: adaptive_vs_threshold_reward
description: Table 16 compares threshold and adaptive rewards. Adaptive is higher for IQA Avg 0.824/0.827 versus 0.801/0.790 and ISTA 0.778/0.767 versus 0.303/0.334, while threshold IAA Avg 0.617/0.596 exceeds UniPercept 0.590/0.586. Table 17 gives threshold 72.32/76.29/81.65% and Avg 76.75% versus UniPercept 76.55/81.07/84.23% and Avg 80.62%.

name: without_domain_adaptive_pretraining
description: Removing DAPT lowers VR IAA Avg to 0.481/0.421, IQA Avg to 0.733/0.700, and ISTA to 0.755/0.732, and lowers VQA to 69.16/75.09/80.00% versus UniPercept 76.55/81.07/84.23%.

name: vqa_only_vs_vr_only
description: VQA-only and VR-only each underperform the joint model on most target summaries. The VR table has a counter-cell: VQA-only IAA PLCC 0.598 exceeds joint 0.586.

name: multi_domain_vs_single_domain
description: IAA-only, IQA-only, and ISTA-only models perform best on parts of their own domains but have lower VQA averages 72.98%, 72.76%, and 73.80% than UniPercept 80.62%; ISTA-only ISTA VQA is 82.27% versus 84.23%.

name: ablation_location
description: All ablation tables are in Supplementary 10.2 on p.23; no ablation table appears in the main text p.1-p.10.

name: Method-component deletion
description: No ablation removes an inner/outer-subgrammar definition, loss term, or architectural component; 'ablated' in §5.2 refers to changing x and y training durations.

name: Subgrammar location
description: Prefix/infix/suffix pretraining tests positional sensitivity in ABC Grammar.

name: Pretraining duration and model scale
description: Tables 1 and 4 vary pretraining epochs and layer/size configurations; Figure 6 contrasts two and four layers.

name: Recursion probability
description: Figure 5 varies p in the simple recursive grammar to visualize Theorem 4.6 behavior.

name: Prefix robustness
description: Appendix E.4 compares valid, nested valid, and invalid prefixes at depth.

name: Incremental protocol
description: 组件按 pipeline order 增加，每一步从前一步最佳配置初始化；baseline 使用 dense keyframe、fixed temporal partitioning 和 minimal overlap。

name: Redundancy Filtering
description: Table 4 分离 Parallax-Based Keyframe Selection 与 Static Redundancy Pruning，并同时报告整体 ATE 与 stop-and-go ATE*。

name: Submap Partitioning
description: Table 5 比较 Temporal Slicing、Parallax-Triggered 和 Topology-Aware，识别 Turning Segment Encapsulation 的拓扑作用。

name: Submap Alignment
description: Figure 6 改变 overlap size 并比较 Dense registration 与 ADSR，识别 anchor/filtering 对误差和计算时间的影响。

name: Loop Keyframe Reuse
description: Appendix Table 6 比较 CBA loop anchor 的 bidirectional 与 unidirectional reuse，ATE 18.31→18.26 m、Drift 0.930→0.928%。

name: Any-Order IP (AO-IP)
description: The stated random-insertion-policy variant tests whether learning the insertion order matters. Its unconditional validity is 88.2 versus 97.4 for classifier-based IP and its conditional validity is lower in all four listed tasks.

name: Component removal ablations
description: No separate removal study for the encoder, decoder, termination head, RLOO, or permutation mapping appears in the read PDF.

name: Termination comparison
description: Policy-based and classifier-based IP rows are compared in Table 3; the prose says the classifier variant consistently outperforms the policy variant for this task.

name: Dedicated main-text ablation section
description: No main-body Ablation heading or component-deletion experiment; relevant tests are Appendix D.

name: Payment computation algorithm tradeoff
description: Appendix D.2 compares exact, randomized N, and one-shot mechanisms to identify compute-variance-bias tradeoffs.

name: Loss and regularization sensitivity
description: Appendix D.4 changes hinge/log/squared-hinge and C=c(m) schedules across m.

name: Valuation variance
description: Appendix D.5 changes Gamma shape while holding the mean valuation fixed.

name: Algorithm-family contrast
description: Appendix D.6 contrasts SVM with k-NN across four k values to support the theoretical discrepancy.

name: Value-construction heterogeneity
description: Figure 3 compares feature-based and label-based artificial valuation constructions.

name: Controlled component-removal ablation
description: The paper explicitly says it does not perform controlled ablations of Agent-FLAN's training design; no standard component deletion study appears elsewhere.

name: IR smoothing sensitivity
description: IR is shown at alpha=0.5, 1, and 2 on both benchmark families; authors say the results remain highly consistent. This is metric sensitivity, not a component ablation.

name: Epoch-wise training sensitivity
description: Sections 7 and Appendix J track eight training epochs to diagnose temporal dynamics; this varies training duration/checkpoint rather than removing a method component.
